description: Synthetic evaluation set for evidence-grounded case Q&A. All organizations, people, domains (.example) and addresses (RFC 5737 documentation ranges) are invented. Two cases are seeded so cross-case leakage can be measured. Version 2 keeps every v1 question and evidence record unchanged (split 'development') and adds four evidence records and eight 'holdout' questions for the failure modes seen in the v2 model run (unnecessary abstention on JSON records and Turkish dates, unlabelled conflicts) plus near-miss questions that must still abstain. Holdout questions were written and frozen before the prompt changes they test and were not used to tune them.
